title: Thinking on Coding, Creativity & Culture with Computational Mama
summary: Divya talks with Computational Mama (aka Manasi K) about her path from museum exhibition designer to creative coder, how the moniker gave her room to grow into a new identity, and what it means to find creative coding as a designer rather than as a STEM-trained engineer. They cover finding mentors who let you fail, balancing tinkering with motherhood and housework, and the influence of her tinkering father and designer mother.

to think about identity and giving yourself a new name to grow into
